name: keep-regex
description:
What a regular expression matches in a phrase, case-sensitive, searched anywhere.

pattern: the regular expression; \w, \b and \d take Cyrillic letters too.
all_matches: extract gives every match, joined by a space; by default the first.
invert: the found part is the text the pattern does not match: remove keeps only the matches, joined with nothing between («диван 120x200» with \d+ → «120200»); extract gives the text outside the matches («диван x»); find marks the phrases where such text is left.

find marks the phrases where the pattern matches; remove cuts out every match; extract gives the first match.

Example: semkit read --text "диван 120x200" --text "кресло" keep-regex "\d+" write -
-> диван 120x200

keep-regex keeps only the rows where the matcher finds something in the working column.
